title: Stream-proof overlay setup for Aion 2
desc: Hide ESP wallhack and script overlays from OBS, capture tools and cards—test workflow for content creators.

body.text: Streaming Aion 2 with visible ESP wallhack or script menus risks platform bans and viewer reports. Stream-proof mode on [Lite](/products/aion-2-cheats/) and [Pro](/products/aion-2-cheats/) hides overlays from OBS, Xbox capture tools, and most software capture—while keeping ESP visible on your physical monitor.
Stream-proof overview

Streaming Aion 2 with visible ESP wallhack or script menus risks platform bans and viewer reports. Creators run awareness privately while keeping broadcast feed clean—discipline still required in commentary.
Enable stream-proof in loader
Open utility tab in operator portal or external loader. Toggle stream-proof overlay hiding before launching OBS—not after.
Apply before Aion 2 if your capture software hooks at game start. Elite operators use the same toggle for bot and Costume Changer menus.
OBS test workflow
Record 30 seconds locally with your live scene collection. Playback must show clean game feed—no drop dots, player ESP, or script HUD.
Test game capture and display capture modes separately; dual-monitor setups behave differently. Browser source overlays unaffected by game capture stream-proof.
Capture tools and cards
Windows Game Bar capture respects stream-proof on most builds—verify with Win+G clip.
Hardware capture cards reading raw HDMI may still show overlays if signal passes through composited path. Test exact cable chain before going live.
Pair with conservative ESP
Stream-proof hides overlays from capture; it does not make gameplay legit on stream if you call out hidden info.
Creators often run [Lite](/products/aion-2-cheats/) awareness privately while keeping broadcast commentary clean. Map defaults: [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/aion-2-esp-wallhack-setup/).
Costume Changer and capture
[Costume Changer](/blog/aion-2-costume-changer-guide/) cosmetics may appear on capture depending on client path—test separately from ESP stream-proof.
Flashy outfit particles on stream can look suspicious even when ESP is hidden—plan content accordingly.
Get stream-safe cheats
Stream-proof ships with all tiers at [Aion 2 Cheats](/products/aion-2-cheats/) on aion2cheats.net. Checkout via secure checkout.
Full feature list in [cheats features guide](/blog/aion-2-cheats-features-guide/)—Lite minimum for zoom plus ESP plus stream-proof trio.
